cards.question: When does Rc drop the inner value?
cards.answer: It keeps a count of owners and drops the value only when the counter reaches 0.

cards.question: How does Rc::clone differ from cloning a Box?
cards.answer: It does not allocate a new heap value. It increments the counter next to the value. Dropping a clone decrements; at 0 the value is dropped.

cards.question: How do you get a mutable reference from Rc?
cards.answer: Use interior mutability, or Rc::get_mut / Rc::make_mut. Those unique-mut methods only work with a single reference. Rc::strong_count reports the count.

cards.question: Why can't Rc be sent across threads?
cards.answer: It is not thread-safe and does not implement Send or Sync. Two threads updating the count at once produce inconsistent behaviour.
